gap_1_and_11_cancel_consumption.expectation: For each SDK, a long generation interrupted after streaming starts makes the local provider stop generating: vllm:num_requests_running returns to 0 within 10 s of the interrupt, and vllm:generation_tokens_total does not grow across two later settle windows. The native logs (Codex rollout token_count, Claude session JSONL usage and ResultMessage usage) will under-report the interrupted request against the provider's prompt and generation token deltas.
criteria: provider metrics sampled before the turn, at interrupt, after settle 1 and after settle 2 (10 s each), with the per-SDK request isolated (no other client on the server)
consumption stops: generation_tokens_total(settle2) == generation_tokens_total(settle1) and num_requests_running == 0 at settle1
detector: a control request that is not interrupted must show generation_tokens_total growing by its completion_tokens, so the counter can see consumption
provider-side prompt and generation deltas recorded next to the SDK-reported usage and the native session-log usage for the same request
gap 1 stays advanced unless hosted-provider consumption becomes observable; the local provider is a substitute channel, not the hosted accounts
gap 11 stays advanced: hosted billing and multi-host recovery are not tested; the zombie-worker arm below only strengthens the one-host exactly-once evidence

gap_11_zombie_worker.expectation: A Temporal worker paused with SIGSTOP mid-activity (a stand-in for a partition or long GC pause) loses its activity to a second worker after the heartbeat timeout; when resumed with SIGCONT, the stale worker's effect write is rejected by the idempotency key and its completion is not accepted by the server. The effect row count stays 1.
criteria: attempt 1 on worker A (paused), attempt 2 on worker B completes the workflow
after SIGCONT, worker A's effect attempt is recorded as refused (key exists) and the workflow result is from worker B
effect rows == 1; negative control without the idempotency key writes 2 rows (detector)
one host only; labelled local_integration

gap_9_matched_comparison.expectation: One fixed task (vault_lookup custom tool returning a random value, a long-essay turn interrupted mid-stream, then a new-process resume asking for the stored value) runs through both SDKs against the same local model and provider. The Codex SDK registers the tool as a thread dynamicTool; the Claude Agent SDK registers it through create_sdk_mcp_server. Both are scored on the checklist carried over from round 1: structured events typed, custom-tool round trip, mid-turn interrupt status, resume recall in a new process.
criteria: custom-tool round trip: the host-side handler is called with key alpha and the model's final answer contains the handler's value
interrupt: the SDK reports an interrupted/aborted terminal state and the provider shows the request ended (num_requests_running 0)
resume: a new OS process resumes the same thread/session id and returns the turn-1 value without calling the tool (a decoy handler value must not appear)
structured events: every received event is a typed SDK object (Codex: not UnknownNotification; Claude: SDK message classes)
settled only if both SDKs complete all four items on the same task; model-quality failures of the small local model are recorded as such and leave the gap advanced
scope stated in the receipt: SDK-level comparison with one open-weight model; hosted gpt/claude models are not part of this arm

gap_8_openhands_real_model.expectation: The OpenHands SDK (1.49.4, existing venv) runs a local Conversation with a real model through LiteLLM (openai-compatible base_url to the loopback vLLM), and the agent uses the terminal or file-editor tool to create a file with a requested content. If openhands-agent-server installs into a fresh prefix, a second conversation runs through a loopback agent-server process (RemoteWorkspace/remote conversation).
criteria: local conversation: execution status FINISHED, at least one ActionEvent from the model (not TestLLM), the file exists with the requested content, provider request count > 0
remote arm: conversation created on the loopback agent-server, events returned over its API, the file exists in the server's workspace
container arm: attempted only if an agent-server image and a docker-compatible runtime are available without touching shared container storage; otherwise named as the remaining blocker
settled only if LangGraph and Temporal (round 1) plus an OpenHands real-model conversation hold and the remote/container clause is exercised; otherwise advanced with the remainder named

round4_review_fix.label: fix-round preregistration, written after the cross-family review of 594de02..b59b175 (codex exec, read-only, gpt-6-astra) and before any fix or rerun; not back-dated
findings_and_plan: 1 (major, supported): the container arm ran with --network host and the image's VSCode service bound 0.0.0.0:8001 on the host network for about a minute, breaking the loopback-only rule. Plan: record the deviation; rerun the container arm with podman's pasta network (container ports stay in the container namespace; only 127.0.0.1:28433 is published; the container reaches the model through a pasta -T 28431 forward), OH_ENABLE_VSCODE=false, and a host listener snapshot (ss -ltnp) taken while the container runs. Expectation: the snapshot shows no new non-loopback listener and the conversation finishes with the token file in the container. Gap 8 stays settled only if the rerun passes; otherwise advanced.

2 (major, supported): the gap-9 typed-event check saw only turn-routed Codex notifications, and the Claude SDK silently drops unknown message types. Plan: tap every notification before routing (Codex: MessageRouter.route_notification) and every raw CLI message before parsing (Claude: message_parser.parse_message) in the session and resume phases; add detectors (an unknown method and a malformed known method must classify as untyped; an unknown Claude message type must be counted as dropped). Rerun 3 session trials and 1 resume per SDK. Gap 9 is settled only if every tapped item is typed (or explicitly a documented type) in all reruns and the detectors fire; otherwise advanced.

3 (major, supported): 'late completions were rejected by the server' is not observed; the worker log shows worker-side cancellation. Plan: remove the claim; state what the history shows (one ActivityTaskCompleted, result from attempt 4).
4 (minor): rename the predicate in the receipt (retry on worker B, with the actual attempt number) from the raw data; the raw key name stays as recorded.
5 (minor): derive checked_at from every contributing run.
6 (minor): the repeated Codex token_count precedes turn_aborted; fix the wording.
8 (minor): record the download command with its import.
